what: backbone-strength audit: the shipped lineup re-measured under strictly weaker/fewer backbones on the full official val splits under the aligned protocol

inventory.name: SAM ViT-H automatic mask generator
inventory.role: proposal pool for the RefCOCO family (and gRefCOCO via term boxes)

inventory.name: CLIP ViT-B/16 (released modified tower, G2L masked-region features + text)
inventory.role: region-text platform of the head and the released scores

inventory.name: LLaVA-OneVision-7B box prior
inventory.role: referent box on the RefCOCO family (full-expression prompt)

inventory.name: GroundingDINO-base detector gate
inventory.role: second box source on the gRefCOCO path only

inventory.name: Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct box prior (backbone-audit arm)
inventory.role: strictly smaller local VLM replacing the 7B prior in arm (a)

inventory.name: SAM ViT-B automatic mask generator (backbone-audit arm)
inventory.role: strictly smaller proposal pool in arm (b)

inventory.name: Plain masked-region CLIP ViT-B/16 (backbone-audit arm)
inventory.role: weaker region-text platform (our own masking; no G2L fusion, no complement blur) in arm (c)
inventory.provenance: ours (text protocol) over generic frozen weights

inventory.name: Learned selector head
inventory.role: shipped RefCOCO-family pick (declared trained on train-carved rows)

swaps.name: smaller VLM box source: Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct (3.8B) for the 7B LLaVA-OneVision prior
swaps.weaker_variant: Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct (strictly fewer parameters), same prompt template; head refit on train-carved rows with the 3B boxes (deployment-consistent); measured BETTER than the 7B LLaVA boxes on all three datasets -- grounding quality here is family-limited, not size-limited
swaps.note: strictly smaller than both the incumbent 7B and the rival's cloud MLLM

swaps.name: smaller proposal pool: SAM ViT-B (0.09B) for SAM ViT-H (0.64B)
swaps.weaker_variant: SAM ViT-B automatic masks (pps=8, same released thresholds), G2L features re-extracted, head refit on SAM-B train-carved rows
swaps.note: ViT-L was the first choice; the original-format ViT-L checkpoint is not reachable offline (HF port restructures the prompt encoder), so the strictly smaller ViT-B is the measured arm

swaps.name: weaker region-text platform: plain masked-region CLIP (no G2L fusion, no complement blur)
swaps.weaker_variant: our own masked-region CLIP ViT-B/16 features (mask fill + resize + CLS), head refit on train-carved rows with the plain features
swaps.note: removes the released G2L fusion and complement-blur path entirely

swaps.name: gRefCOCO without the GroundingDINO detector (fewer components than the rival)
swaps.weaker_variant: training-free termbox rule with LLaVA nounboxes only; no detector boxes, no detector-box-prompted SAM masks
swaps.note: cIoU drops below the same-class floor when the detector is removed: the detector is load-bearing on the gRefCOCO path and the drop is kept as the measured boundary

verdict: Scoped, component by component (full official val, aligned protocol; the reference and head were refit on train-carved rows wherever the platform or pool changed): (a) the box prior can be SMALLER AND BETTER -- Qwen2.5-VL-3B (3.8B, strictly smaller than both the 7B incumbent and the rival's cloud MLLM) holds SOTA on all three datasets and improves on the shipped boxes (73.57/67.64/66.43 vs 70.57/66.35/65.51 mIoU), so grounding quality here is family-limited, not size-limited; (c) the region-text platform can be weakened for free -- plain masked-region CLIP without the released G2L fusion or complement blur keeps full-table SOTA at -0.2..-0.4 mIoU (70.22/65.98/65.32). Two boundaries are measured and kept: (b) SAM ViT-B's pool oracle falls from 79.1 to 71.4 mIoU on RefCOCOg and the refit head lands 57.57, 0.28 BELOW the published GLOD-RIS floor -- the ViT-H pool is load-bearing there; and (d) the detector-free gRefCOCO rule scores 38.71 cIoU, below the same-class 44.4 floor -- the extra detector is load-bearing there. 2/4 swap arms still clear their floors.
